objective: Deerhorn Mountain's NE couloir on skis from Onion Valley

route_source.approximation_note: A planning sketch, not a travelled line: trail geometry to Kearsarge Pass, then a hand-drawn crossing of the Pinnacles 9-10 notch and descent to Bubbs Creek (provisional, no skiable exit verified); the return by Bullfrog Lake. Elevations are smoothed bare-earth estimates, not snow surface.

selected.name: Round trip - out by the Kearsarge Pinnacles 9-10 notch, back by Bullfrog Lake
